discovery_limits.result: Search returned historical 2025 ShellHacks rules and unrelated events; it did not establish a 2026 Devpost event or rubric. Attempts at plausible 2026 Devpost URLs were inaccessible and are not evidence that no event page exists.

historical_reference_only.rules_summary: The 2025 rules restricted teams to one submission, required work created during the event, prohibited entering the same project in another hackathon, and required disclosure of reused external code. Libraries, frameworks and open-source code were permitted with attribution.
historical_reference_only.recommendation: Use historical patterns to prepare ideas, skills and evaluation plans, then check the current hacker guide and sponsor briefs before starting implementation or choosing a prize target. Current eligibility and submission rules take priority over historical examples.

coding_audit: EcoSort remains unknown for runtime AI: using an AI coding platform does not itself prove an AI product feature.
Lumi Lens has documented AI dialogue, but its live emotion detection was replaced by simulation in the demo.
Quests and Conflicts VR has no documented runtime AI; this is unknown, not proof that no AI was used.
Happy Head is coded AI/ML based on explicitly named MediaPipe FaceMesh. It does not claim a validated clinical classifier.
Visual-interface flags establish described user-facing interfaces or listed screenshots, not verified demo quality or reliability.
Hardware includes a VR headset for Quests and Conflicts; distinguish that from building custom embedded hardware.
Agent Zero's inclusion flag denotes a stated affordability/access objective, not disability accessibility or independently verified reduced financial exclusion.
Intended social benefits are project goals, not measured real-world outcomes.

confirmed_challenge_followup.edition_confirmation: The user explicitly confirms the eight listed challenges apply to ShellHacks 2026. Accepted without rechecking mixed labels.
confirmed_challenge_followup.inventory_limit: Eight confirmed categories, not an exhaustive inventory. No additional current brief established by the bounded official-source review.
confirmed_challenge_followup.team: Reply 4 interpreted as four teammates; skills, hardware and remaining build time unspecified.
confirmed_challenge_followup.finding: Current general MLH policies provide a judging baseline for MLH categories and require member events to allow generative AI. Event-specific adoption, disclosure, reuse, submission and multi-category/award rules remain unresolved. Generic digital-event requirements are not imported into this in-person event.
confirmed_challenge_followup.recommendation: ReplayBench with Tiger Data, conditional on SQL capability, account access, eligibility and remaining time; Handoff Lab and LineCheck are the alternatives. Scores are analyst judgments, not historical findings or winning probabilities.
confirmed_challenge_followup.no_implementation: Research and planning only; no prototype, accounts, cloud resources, domain registrations or external messages created.
